note: Quality Intelligence V1 measure definition registry for the CMS hospice family. THIS FILE IS THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH FOR MEASURE DIRECTIONALITY. Nothing may infer whether higher or lower is better at query time, render time, or ingestion time - it is read from here, seeded into CmsMeasureDefinition, and read back from the database by cms-hospice-quality.js. 'direction' values come from CMS Hospice Quality Reporting Program documentation (https://www.cms.gov/medicare/quality/hospice/current-measures) and the CMS Hospice Care Index technical report, NOT from inspecting the data. CMS also publishes an H_012_xx_PERCENTILE field for every HCI indicator; it is a plain monotone rank of the RAW value with no directional correction (Spearman rho = 1.0000 against the observed value on all ten indicators in the 2026-08-19 archive), so for a lower-is-better indicator a HIGHER CMS percentile means WORSE care. It is therefore deliberately absent from this registry and must never be surfaced as a quality rank.

dimensions.label: Overall Care Index
dimensions.blurb: A single CMS index summarising ten claims-based indicators of hospice care from admission through discharge.

dimensions.label: Visits in the Final Days of Life
dimensions.blurb: How often patients received a nurse or social worker visit in their last days of life.

dimensions.label: Comprehensive Assessment at Admission
dimensions.blurb: Whether all seven required admission care processes were completed for each patient.

dimensions.label: Continuity of Nursing Visits
dimensions.blurb: How often a hospice election included a gap in skilled nursing visits.

dimensions.label: Live Discharge Pattern
dimensions.blurb: How often patients left hospice care alive, early in or late into their election.

dimensions.label: Weekend and Near-Death Staffing
dimensions.blurb: How nursing effort is distributed across weekends and the period closest to death.

dimensions.label: Family Caregiver Experience
dimensions.blurb: What family caregivers reported in the CMS Hospice CAHPS survey.

measures.directionSource: CMS HQRP: HCI awards one point per indicator met; scores range 0 to a perfect 10.

measures.cmsMeasureName: Hospice Visits in the Last Days of Life
measures.shortLabel: Visits in the final days of life
measures.directionSource: CMS HQRP: proportion of patients receiving an in-person RN or MSW visit on at least 2 of the final 3 days of life.

measures.cmsMeasureName: Hospice and Palliative Care Composite Process Measure
measures.directionSource: CMS HQRP: proportion of patients for whom the hospice performed all seven care processes, as applicable.
CMS HCI indicator 2 (Gaps in Skilled Nursing Visits): lower is better.
CMS HCI indicator 3 (Early Live Discharges): lower is better.
CMS HCI indicator 4 (Late Live Discharges): lower is better.

measures.cmsMeasureName: Skilled nursing minutes on weekends (% minutes)
measures.directionSource: CMS HCI indicator 9 (Skilled Nursing Minutes on Weekends): higher is better.
CMS HCI indicator 10 (Visits Near Death): higher is better.
CMS Hospice CAHPS summary star rating: 1 to 5 stars, more stars is better.
measures.note: The numeric value lives in the 'Star Rating' column; this measure's 'Score' column is 'Not Applicable' for every one of the 6,669 CCNs in the 2026-08-19 archive.

measures.cmsMeasureName: YES, they would definitely recommend the hospice
measures.directionSource: CMS Hospice CAHPS top-box: a higher share of caregivers who would definitely recommend is better.
